The operation commences in 22 days. I will now brief you on the details.
Its name is Operation Pleiades.
Our objective is to clear out the Cancers nesting in the Hadano Basin in the southwest of Kanagawa prefecture, along the former Route 246, and recapture the base which borders the town of Hakone.
It will be a large-scale operation involving a total of seven squads, including yourselves.
As the assault squad, you will storm the basin in advance of the other squads and thin out the Cancer swarms residing there.
You say it all casual, but we could totally die doing this.
I've been bracing myself for a job like this ever since we were made the assault squad.
After thinning the Cancer ranks, other squads will transport materials and build a bridgehead. Once complete, you'll eliminate the remaining Cancers, ending the operation.
What's a "bridgehead"?
A defensive strongpoint.
Of course, the Cancer are certain to send in reinforcements while the bridgehead is being constructed. You must protect the vicinity at all costs.
I'm sure you can imagine the consequences if the bridgehead were to fall.
Let us just say that death most certainly awaits. In summary, whether this operation succeeds or fails depends entirely on you.
Keep that in mind as you tackle the task at hand. Any questions?
Any questions?
